decisions.summary: Keep the 9 withdrawals discoverable. Approve 8 lodging relabels and 2 rejections. Approve the 27 upgrades where the refreshed record confirms them. Defer the 26 downgrades.

decisions.decided_by: Chuck Price (owner), relayed by the coordinator
decisions.summary: Accept 13 named Campground and 2 named Dispersed Campground upgrades. Review the other 12 individually. Keep all 9 withdrawals listed with a pending notice. Accept 16 keeps, 3 Dispersed and 7 Other. Hold any keep that depends only on a name-and-point match.

rule: A name plus point match is candidate evidence only. Another agency's fields classify a listing only with a shared facility id or an independently verified link to that exact facility.
later_withdrawal_requirement: Any later withdrawal needs a tested notice page for every canonical and legacy id it retires.
